class.name: OMTOutput
class.brief_description: Sends a Viewport as an Open Media Transport source.
class.description: Set source_name and enabled to publish the selected viewport over OMT. Audio can be sent with send_audio_frame() while the output is running.

method.name: send_audio_frame
method.description: Sends interleaved 32-bit floating point PCM samples as an OMT FPA1 audio frame. The method converts the samples to planar audio before sending.
